name: Maurice El Médiouni
description:
'''Maurice El Médiouni''', also spelled '''Maurice el Medioni''', ({{langx|ar|مــوريــس الــمــديــونــي}}; 18 October 1928 – 25 March 2024) was an [[Algerians|Algerian]] pianist, [[songwriter]] and interpreter of [[Chaabi (Algeria)|Algerian chaabi]], [[Franco-Arab chanson]], [[raï]] and [[world music]]. He is known for his performances in the 1950s and 1960s with other artists from the [[Maghreb]] such as [[Lili Labassi]], [[Line Monty]], [[Lili Boniche]], [[Samy el Maghribi]], and [[Reinette l’Oranaise]].

In his later years, he attracted new acclaim with albums such as ''Café Oran'' and ''Descarga Oriental'', the latter with Cuban-American jazz musician [[Roberto Juan Rodríguez|Roberto Rodriguez]], gaining the 2007 [[BBC Radio 3 World Music Awards|BBC Radio 3 World Music Award]].
